$schema_note: Production engine configuration (shared by all productions). Model IDs and prices change often: verify them on the provider's website before any paid run. A price of null means 'not verified' and the engine refuses to run that model.

azure.note: The studio's Foundry resource (studio/infra). Entra ID only; network security perimeter admits only the studio PC. Spending counts against its own monthly limit (budget me-eus2-mtowerstudio-budget).

deployment_endpoints.$note: Deployments hosted on the second-region media Foundry (East US 2 quota for them is held by the legacy MTower Foundry).

image_compose.price_note: Token-billed (gpt-image-2, Global Standard, eastus2 retail meters 2026-10-12): $5 text in, $8 image in, $30 image out per 1M tokens. Per-image prices are safe ceilings for 1280x720; the ledger records the ACTUAL cost from the token usage the API returns. Reference photos add image-input tokens (ceiling $0.03 each).
image_compose.verify: Hard compositions (crowds, props, exact poses) with prop reference photos; no face models — the face pass adds the cast's faces

image_compose_flux.price_note: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro] on Foundry, Global Standard: $0.04 per image (flat).
image_compose_flux.verify: Compositions with children: Azure gpt-image-2 / 2.5-flare and FLUX.2-pro all refuse photorealistic minors (tested 2026-10-12); FLUX.1 Kontext pro accepts them. Text only (no prop reference photos); the face pass adds the cast's faces

image_draft.verify: Check the model page and price on fal.ai
image_draft.price_note: $0.025 per megapixel, rounded up; our image sizes are under 1 MP, so this is per image. Verified on fal.ai 2026-10-11.

image_final.verify: Check the model page and price on fal.ai
image_final.price_note: $0.04 per megapixel, rounded up; our image sizes are under 1 MP, so this is per image. Verified on fal.ai 2026-10-11.

image_ultra.verify: Raw mode gives more natural, less idealized faces

image_lora.verify: Shots and tests with trained actor LoRAs (FLUX.1 dev base)
image_lora.price_note: $0.035 per megapixel, rounded up; our sizes are under 1 MP, so this is per image. Verified on fal.ai 2026-10-11.

image_edit_identity.verify: Identity-preserving feature edits of an approved actor portrait (hair, grooming, age cues) — Kontext redraws the face on large changes (studio cast audit 2026-10-18)

image_edit.verify: Reference editing: same person in a new angle, light, expression, or outfit (LoRA training sets)

voice_azure.price_note: Azure Speech on the Foundry resource, eastus2 retail 2026-10-12: Neural HD $22 per 1M characters (standard neural is cheaper); $0.022 per 1k characters is the ceiling for every voice.
voice_azure.verify: Temporary / comparison narrator (Look Test). ElevenLabs remains the planned final voice.

voice_gpt_audio.price_note: Character voices and narration (D-20/D-21): gpt-audio-1.5 (2026-02-23), GlobalStandard. Token-billed; the actual cost of each take is computed from the response usage with pricing_per_m_tokens (OpenAI list price, same on Azure Global). price_usd per second of speech + per_call_usd (the long acting direction) are planning ceilings.

voice_gpt_mini_tts.price_note: gpt-4o-mini-tts (2025-12-15): about $0.015 per minute of speech ($12 per 1M audio tokens + $0.60 per 1M text tokens); used for crowd voices.

lipsync_kling_avatar.verify: Lip-sync talking shots: keyframe + voice line → video with the line in sync (user pick 2026-10-13, Dialogue Test).

lipsync_minimax.verify: Needs at least 5 s of audio; no prompt.

qa_review.price_note: gpt-5.6-sol Global Standard, eastus2 retail meters 2026-10-12: $4 input, $20 output per 1M tokens (short context). One review = the image + up to 5 reference images + the rubric (about 4-5k tokens in, 2-3.5k out incl. reasoning): measured $0.05-0.085 (2026-10-12); $0.10 is the ceiling. The ledger records the actual cost from the usage.
qa_review.verify: Vision QA reviewer (mtower qa): checks each image against its design, anatomy, identity, period, props, physics, location rules, light and artifacts; JSON verdict saved as <image>.qa.json

script_review.price_note: Same deployment and meters as qa_review. One beat = the rubric, the cast, the beat's text and its neighbours (about 5-7k tokens in) and a line-by-line verdict with rewrites and reasoning (up to ~12k out): ceiling $0.30; the ledger records the actual cost.
script_review.verify: Script QA board (mtower script-qa): Egyptian street dialect, 1973 army register, intensity vs situation, character voice, drama, history and series rules, diacritics for TTS, lip-sync length

face_swap.price_note: Token-billed like image_compose: frame + anchor portrait in, one 1280x720 image out. Measured $0.043 (2.5-07, 2026-10-12); $0.06 is the ceiling. The ledger records the actual cost.

check.note: Re-detects the face after the swap (+$0.02 on fal). Off by default: the QA reviewer (mtower qa / autofix) measures head size, placement and light on every image anyway.

face_swap.verify: Default face pass (adults): gpt-image-2 masked edit with the actor's approved anchor portrait as image 2. Keeps the frame's head size, angle and moonlight, which the fal LoRA inpaint did not (2.5-07: head grew, turned to camera, warm-lit). Children stay on fal (gpt-image refuses minors). Faces are found with face_detect (fal, $0.02) unless the batch already has faces.json; the check re-detects after the swap.

image_inpaint.price_note: $0.035 per megapixel, rounded up; keyframes are 0.92 MP, so this is per image. Verified with the fal pricing API 2026-10-12.

patch.note: Face pass works on a close-up: a square 2.6x the face is enlarged to 960x960 (0.92 MP, one price unit), repainted, then blended back

image_inpaint.verify: Face pass for group shots: repaints only the lead's face with the actor's face model

face_detect.price_note: Moondream 2 object detection, $0.02 per request. Verified with the fal pricing API 2026-10-12.
face_detect.verify: Finds EVERY face (normalised boxes). Chosen 2026-10-12: Florence-2 found 0 faces in a sunlit 6-man group (3.13-01) where Moondream found all 6

face_detect_fallback.price_note: $0.00125 per compute second (about 1-3 s per image); $0.005 is a safe ceiling. Verified with the fal pricing API 2026-10-12.
face_detect_fallback.verify: Used only when the primary detector finds fewer faces than leads; returns the single most face-like box

lora_training.price_note: $2 per training run at 1,000 steps, scales linearly with steps. Verified on fal.ai 2026-10-11.
lora_training.verify: Trains an actor face LoRA for FLUX.1 dev; output works with fal-ai/flux-lora

video_default.chosen: 2026-10-12 by the user after the 2.5-05 bake-off (more alive than Kling v3 Pro; Veo refused)

video_premium.price_checked: 2026-10-12, fal pricing API: $0.15 per second (the with-audio price; without audio may be lower)

sfx_video.negative_prompt: speech, talking, voices, singing, music, melody
sfx_video.note: Video-to-audio: sound effects generated from a clip's motion, so they land on the action (spot effects).

sfx_text.note: Text-to-sound: seamless loops for continuous beds (rotor, wind) laid under several shots.

voice.verify: Check the ElevenLabs plan price per 1,000 characters

face_pass.note: azure = face_swap (gpt-image-2 masked edit with the anchor portrait, default); fal = image_inpaint (LoRA). Children always use fal. A shot can set face_method.

qa_gate.note: Agreed with the user 2026-10-13: images that go to video need QA 8/10; casting portraits, posters and other artifacts 7/10. Below the gate (or without a review) the gallery approves only with a written director's override, saved in approved.json.

$cost_note: fal bills image models per megapixel rounded UP, so any size up to 1.0 MP costs the same as a tiny one. Keyframes use 1280x720 (0.92 MP, matches 720p video input) at the 1 MP price. Don't exceed 1 MP: 1344x768 (1.03 MP) costs double.
